findings.title: Build has no product memory bound
findings.standard: WORK_PACKAGES.md:171; prior F06 resource boundary in V01-V02-acceptance-review.md:69-77 / reacceptance-review.md:106
findings.explanation: Build invokes _run_once with address_space_limit_mb=0 and omits rss_limit_mb, which defaults to 0. Thus neither product memory path is enabled for build. The outer acceptance container 2GiB limit is infrastructure, not a product runner bound.

findings.title: Output capture is polled, not a hard spool limit
findings.standard: WORK_PACKAGES.md:171/173; prior F06/R06 output-resource boundary and author hard-cap assertion at R01-R09-response.md:121-128
findings.explanation: Popen writes directly to regular files. _spool_within_cap only tests existing lengths. It never prevents or truncates writes; process.poll can break before the check. _read_output then hashes the entire file and bounds only the returned excerpt. Existing assertions cover classification and termination after overshoot, not actual capture byte bounds.
